fact: COBAC's 2025 annual report, as reported 2026-10-09, covers payment institutions (non-bank) licensed in the CEMAC, and names Mobile Money Congo SA and Mobile Commerce Congo SA as the payment institutions operating in Congo, whose revenues rose 28.1% to FCFA 20.6 billion in 2025.

ARTF, Congo's money-transfer regulator, said it will enforce from January 2027 the finance law's obligation on every money-transfer and exchange operator to register on its digital platform and use electronic payment terminals; the law is called 'en vigueur', and the article gives no year for the finance law.

ARTF's director said on 5 October 2026 that article 13 of the 2026 finance law obliges money-transfer operators to register on ARTF's digital platform and declare all transfers by the 10th of the following month, with a fine of 20 million FCFA for refusing to interconnect to the ARTF platform.
